name: meridian-system
description: Standalone autonomous futures scalping system for TopstepX

scripts.test:rollover: node -e "const {getExpectedContractId}=require('./index'); const D=(y,m,d)=>new Date(y,m-1,d); const cases=[[D(2026,2,20),'2026-02-20','H26'],[D(2026,3,15),'2026-03-15','H26'],[D(2026,3,16),'2026-03-16','M26'],[D(2026,3,17),'2026-03-17','M26'],[D(2026,6,15),'2026-06-15','U26'],[D(2026,9,14),'2026-09-14','Z26'],[D(2026,12,14),'2026-12-14','H27']]; let pass=0,fail=0; cases.forEach(([dt,label,exp])=>{const got=getExpectedContractId(dt); const ok=got.endsWith(exp); console.log((ok?'✅':'❌'),label,'→ expected',exp,'got',got.split('.').pop()); ok?pass++:fail++;}); console.log(pass+'/'+(pass+fail),'passed');"
scripts.test:quote: node -e "const qs=require('./src/api/quote-stream'),db=require('./src/storage/db'); (async()=>{const tok=db.getSetting('sessionToken'),cid=db.getSetting('selectedContractId')||'CON.F.US.MES.H26'; if(!tok){console.error('No session token — run test:auth first');process.exit(1);} console.log('Connecting to SignalR hub for',cid,'...'); await qs.start(cid,tok); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,8000)); const q=qs.getLatestQuote(); console.log(q?'✅ Quote received:':' No quote after 8s (hub method may need adjustment):', q); qs.stop();})();"
